_note: Rules for systems/httpie. Public signed-out capture of httpie.io: no surface paints machine-private data - nothing was signed into, typed, searched, sent or submitted. httpie.io publishes its own public contact addresses on the legal and blog pages (privacy@/legal@/feedback@httpie.io); they are product-published content and are kept. The CLI docs show example addresses and dummy credentials (john@example.org, user:pass@10.10.1.10, password@hostname) - product-published documentation samples, allowed.
